_doc: Ashfall loop 4 unit ground fx atlas (team-less, no trim mask, no recolour). rect = [x,y,w,h]; anchor = point that goes on the unit ground anchor / corpse position. Built by pipeline/l4fx.py.

frames.name: burn_decal-0
frames.doc: Burn corpse decal for Fire kills (Flamer, Hive spout, Demon Lord). Ground layer. Frame 0 on death, 1 after ~1.5 s, 2 after ~3 s, then hold 2 and fade like the gore splat.

frames.name: flame_cone-0
frames.doc: Flamer flame jet, unit layer (above the target). Points east; rotate to the shot angle about anchor = nozzle (unit anchor + the Flamer nozzle offset, about (+8,-7) at E). 3 frames loop @ ~15 fps while firing. Additive blend OK.
